description: Declaration of the AdbWinUsbEndpointObject class, which manages a handle to a WinUsb endpoint in the Android ADB Windows USB API implementation. It includes methods for reference counting, handle management, asynchronous and synchronous read/write operations, and timeout settings.

classes.name: AdbWinUsbEndpointObject
classes.description: Manages a WinUsb endpoint handle, supporting reference counting, handle closure, asynchronous and synchronous I/O, and timeout configuration.

classes.name: DecrementPendingIO
classes.description: Helper class that decrements the pending IO count upon destruction, ensuring proper tracking of ongoing IO operations.

methods.name: AdbWinUsbEndpointObject
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint object with parent interface, endpoint ID, and index.

methods.name: virtual ~AdbWinUsbEndpointObject
methods.description: Destructor, kept protected to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Overrides base method to manage object lifetime, ensuring deletion in the correct module context.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Called when the handle is closed; aborts pending IOs and removes the object from handle map.

methods.name: CommonAsyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read/write operations with support for overlapped I/O.

methods.name: CommonSyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs synchronous read/write operations with timeout support.

methods.name: SetTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for read/write operations on the endpoint.
